enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Dragontouched: This mythical material was created by combining an unknown metal with ancient enchantments known only by the dragons. This material is said to enchant the wielder as if they were protected by +5 armor enchantment. Additionally it provides leather items with additional flexibility and metal armors additional protection.
Doublestrike 12%: Passive: 12% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Physical Sheltering +28: +28 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Sight Beyond Sight: You can see through all veils, piercing magical and mundane defenses alike. +5% Enhancement bonus to Dodge bypass.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
